titles: The Tiny Island That Changes Countries Every Six Months
Why This River Island Switches Between Spain and France
The World's Strangest Shared Island Border
description:
Pheasant Island sits in a river between France and Spain. Under a centuries-old treaty, it switches countries twice a year.

Hidden Atlas #11

facts.claim: Pheasant Island is administered by Spain from February 1st to July 31st.
According to the terms of the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659, the island remains a condominium under joint sovereignty.
As of January 2018, the island was approximately 200 metres long and 40 metres wide.
